name: Zei
about: Costume test round 2: silhouettes that can't be read as present-day clothing.
descriptor: a young man of eighteen, slim and of medium height, light golden-tan skin, spiky jet-black hair with one electric-blue streak and quick dark eyes, wearing a cropped asymmetric orange shell jacket with one long sleeve and one short sleeve, angular reflective panels and a tall split collar, a black seamless high-neck bodysuit with thin glowing cyan seams, wide segmented grey trousers gathered into ankle cuffs, chunky white sneakers with glowing soles, a thin band around his throat and clear visor glasses pushed up on his head
